UDKGame.ini.info: Primary Renegade X game settings. Edit this INI for server identity, player limits, and GameSpecificMapCycles map voting/rotation. The launcher mirrors this persistent config into the runtime before startup.
UDKGame.ini.content:
[Engine.GameInfo]
DefaultGameType=RenX_Game.Rx_Game
DefaultGame=RenX_Game.Rx_Game
DefaultServerGame=RenX_Game.Rx_Game
PlayerControllerClassName=RenX_Game.Rx_Controller
MaxPlayers={gameserver.slot_limit}
MaxSpectators=2
GameDifficulty=+1.0
bAdminCanPause=false

[Engine.GameReplicationInfo]
ServerName={gameserver.list_name}
MessageOfTheDay={config_parameter id="motd"}

[Engine.AccessControl]
AdminPassword={config_parameter id="admin_password"}
GamePassword={config_parameter id="server_password"}
IPPolicies=ACCEPT;*

[UTGame.UTGame]
bForceRespawn=true
bPlayersMustBeReady=false
NetWait=15
MinNetPlayers=1
bWaitForNetPlayers=false
RestartWait=30
ClientProcessingTimeout=30
GameSpecificMapCycles=(GameClassName="Rx_Game",Maps=("CNC-Field","CNC-Walls","CNC-GoldRush","CNC-Whiteout","CNC-Islands","CNC-LakeSide","CNC-Mesa","CNC-Volcano","CNC-Canyon","CNC-Complex","CNC-Under","CNC-Oasis","CNC-Xmountain"))
GameSpecificMapCycles=(GameClassName="Rx_Game_Survival",Maps=("DEF-DarkNight","DEF-HillSide"))

UDKEngine.ini.info: Network, Steam/query, starting map, and custom-content download settings. The launcher mirrors this persistent config into the runtime before startup.
UDKEngine.ini.content:
[URL]
MapExt=udk
Map=RenX-MenuMap.udk
LocalMap={config_parameter id="map"}.udk
Port={gameserver.game_port}
PeerPort={gameserver.raw_port}

[IpDrv.TcpNetDriver]
AllowDownloads={config_parameter id="allow_downloads"}
MaxClientRate=15000
MaxInternetClientRate=10000
NetServerMaxTickRate=30

[IpDrv.HTTPDownload]
ConnectionTimeout=30
RedirectToURL={config_parameter id="redirect_url"}
UseCompression={config_parameter id="redirect_use_compression"}

[OnlineSubsystemSteamworks.OnlineSubsystemSteamworks]
bEnableSteam=true
QueryPort={gameserver.query_port}
bUseVAC=false
Region=255
ServerBrowserTimeout=10

UDKWeb.ini.info: Optional Renegade X web server settings. Leave disabled unless you are intentionally exposing it. The launcher mirrors this persistent config into the runtime before startup.
UDKWeb.ini.content:
[RenX_Game.Rx_WebServer]
ServerName={gameserver.list_name}
Applicationss="RenX_Game.Rx_WebApplication_Stats"
ApplicationPathss="/ServerInfo"
bEnabled=false

DefaultApplication=1
ExpirationSeconds=86400

map.name: Starting Map
map.info: Starting map. Use the map name without .udk. Map voting and rotation are controlled by the editable INI files.

admin_password.name: Admin/RCON Password
admin_password.info: Writes AdminPassword in UDKGame.ini and provides the RCON/admin password to the container.

server_password.name: Server Password
server_password.info: Writes GamePassword in UDKGame.ini. Leave blank for a public server.

listed.name: List Server
listed.info: On/true lets the server list publicly when networking and firewall rules allow it.

allow_downloads.name: Allow Downloads
allow_downloads.info: On/true allows custom-content downloads where the game supports them.

redirect_url.name: HTTP Redirect URL
redirect_url.info: Fast-download redirect URL. Use a trailing slash.

runtime_auto_update.name: Runtime Auto Update
runtime_auto_update.info: On/true checks the manifest at server start and applies newer Totem Arts runtime payloads before launch.

update_manifest_url.name: Update Manifest URL
update_manifest_url.info: Manifest used by Runtime Auto Update.

update_channel.name: Update Channel
update_channel.info: Release channel for the manifest check.

server_payload_urls.name: Server Payload URLs
server_payload_urls.info: Fallback URLs for the Renegade X 20-map core runtime. Leave unchanged unless publishing a new payload.

refresh_server_payload.name: Refresh Server Payload
refresh_server_payload.info: Off/false uses the baked or cached runtime. On/true forces payload reinstall on next start.

install_optional_map_pack_one.name: Install Optional Map Pack 1
install_optional_map_pack_one.info: On/true downloads optional map pack 1 on next start.

install_optional_map_pack_two.name: Install Optional Map Pack 2
install_optional_map_pack_two.info: On/true downloads optional map pack 2 on next start.

install_optional_map_pack_three.name: Install Optional Map Pack 3
install_optional_map_pack_three.info: On/true downloads optional map pack 3 on next start.

optional_map_pack_one_url.name: Optional Map Pack 1 URL
optional_map_pack_one_url.info: Public archive URL used when Optional Map Pack 1 is enabled.

optional_map_pack_two_url.name: Optional Map Pack 2 URL
optional_map_pack_two_url.info: Public archive URL used when Optional Map Pack 2 is enabled.

optional_map_pack_three_url.name: Optional Map Pack 3 URL
optional_map_pack_three_url.info: Public archive URL used when Optional Map Pack 3 is enabled.
